chooser.title: How do you practise?
chooser.description: Two short set-ups. Either one ends on your court day, with the briefs for the next listed day.

solo.title: Just me
solo.body: A solo advocate. Add your profile, import your cause lists and orders, then see your court day.
solo.cta: Set up as a solo advocate

chamber.title: A chamber
chamber.body: An advocate with juniors and a clerk. Invite your colleagues, set who sees what, then import together.

resume.title: You have a set-up in progress
resume.body: Carry on from step {step} of {total} in {workspace}.

india.body: Your data is stored in India. AI runs in India-only mode by default.

workspace.label: Workspace
workspace.title: Name your workspace
workspace.purpose: This is where your matters, briefs and court days will live.
workspace.why: Why we ask: your workspace keeps your data apart from everyone else's.

profile.label: Profile
profile.title: Your practice profile
profile.purpose: Tell us who you are, so we can recognise your matters in a cause list.
profile.why: Why we ask: your enrolment number is how we match listings to you, and nothing else.

courts.label: Courts
courts.title: Where do you appear?
courts.purpose: Choose the courts you appear in. Add more any time.
courts.why: Why we ask: we only look for your matters in the courts you choose.

import.label: Import
import.title: Bring your matters in
import.purpose: Forward, share or upload what you already have. You never retype a case.
import.why: Why we ask: your own papers are the only source. We do not search courts for you without your say.

confirm.label: Confirm
confirm.title: Confirm what we found
confirm.purpose: Approve, merge or split each proposed matter. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
confirm.why: Why we ask: you stay in charge of your record.

done.label: Ready
done.title: You are set up
done.purpose: Your court day is the first thing you will see.
done.why: Your data stays in India, and nothing is sent to anyone.

invite.label: Invite
invite.title: Invite your chamber
invite.purpose: Add your juniors and your clerk by email. Only colleagues you already work with.
invite.why: Why we ask: invitations are the only way people join. We send no marketing.

roles.label: Roles
roles.title: Who can see what
roles.purpose: Check what each role can see before anyone joins. The clerk starts restricted.
roles.why: Why we show this: strategy notes and matter memory are for advocates and juniors only.

delegation.label: Delegation
delegation.title: Delegation defaults
delegation.purpose: Choose how appearances are handed out by default. Change them any time.
delegation.why: Why we ask: these are only defaults, and you can reassign any appearance.

brief-format.label: Brief format
brief-format.title: Your brief format
brief-format.purpose: Pick how long a brief is by default. Everyone can set their own later.
brief-format.why: Why we ask: the first brief you open will use this.

nav.skipHint: You can do this later from Settings.

errors.nameRequired: Enter a name for the workspace.
errors.nameInvalid: That name cannot be used. Try another.
errors.generic: We could not create the workspace. Nothing was saved. Try again.

profile.enrolmentHint: As on your bar council certificate, for example MS/1234/2019.

councils.tamil_nadu_puducherry: Bar Council of Tamil Nadu and Puducherry
councils.maharashtra_goa: Bar Council of Maharashtra and Goa

profile.languagesHint: Names and notes can be typed in English, Tamil or Kannada.

errors.summary: Fix the highlighted fields to continue.
errors.enrolment: Enter your enrolment number, for example MS/1234/2019.
errors.practiceAreas: Choose at least one practice area.
errors.generic: We could not save your profile. Nothing was changed. Try again.

courts.searchPlaceholder: Type a court or a city
courts.defaultNote: We preselected the principal seat of the High Court in {city}. Change it if you appear elsewhere.
courts.selected: {count, plural, one {# court chosen} other {# courts chosen}}

errors.generic: We could not save your courts. Nothing was changed. Try again.

forward.title: Forward
forward.body: Forward cause lists and orders from your email to your own address. Only you can read it, and you can switch it off.
forward.revoked: This address is off. Create a new one to forward again.
forward.unavailable: Forwarding by email is not switched on for this workspace yet. Use Share or Upload below, nothing is lost.

share.title: Share
share.body: On your phone, share a cause list, an order or a photo to CauseDeck from any app. Install CauseDeck to your home screen first.
share.hint: Shared files arrive in your inbox and join this import.

upload.title: Upload
upload.body: Upload cause lists, orders, a calendar file (.ics) or photos of your diary pages. Each file shows its progress.

import.empty: Nothing imported yet. Pick any lane above, or skip and start with an empty board.
import.skipNote: Skipping is fine. You will land on a guided board, and the demo workspace is one click away.
import.offline: You are offline. Importing needs a connection, so it is paused. Skip for now, or come back when you are online.
import.denied: Only people who can edit matters can import. Ask the chamber owner to import, or to change your role.
import.forwardFailed: We could not create the address. Share or Upload still work.

confirm.intro: Check each proposed matter. You can approve, merge or split. Nothing is saved to your matters until you confirm.
confirm.noBatch: There is nothing to confirm yet. Import something first, or skip this step.
confirm.loadFailed: We could not load the proposed matters. Nothing was saved. Try again.
confirm.applied: {count, plural, one {# matter saved} other {# matters saved}}.

done.reveal: Your court day for {date} is ready.
done.revealNone: Your board is ready. No hearings are listed yet.
done.revealNoneHint: Import a cause list or add a matter, and your court day fills in here.
done.openBriefs: See the briefs for this day
done.demoHint: Fictional data, one click away. Your own workspace is untouched.

summary.briefs: {count, plural, one {# brief ready} other {# briefs ready}}
summary.obligations: {count, plural, one {# obligation in your starter queue} other {# obligations in your starter queue}}

failed.seatLimit: {email}: your plan has no seat left for this role.

errors.summary: Fix the highlighted rows to continue.
errors.none: Add at least one person, or skip for now.

invite.privacy: Invitations go only to the addresses you enter, and only now. No marketing, ever.

roles.explainer: The clerk starts restricted. A clerk cannot see strategy notes or matter memory. A clerk does see the court day, hearing times and the papers to carry.
roles.change: You can change any role later in Settings, under Members.

delegation.suggestHint: We suggest an assignment for each listed item. You approve it.
delegation.notify: Tell the person when they are assigned
delegation.notifyHint: A notice in CauseDeck only. Nothing leaves the chamber.

errors.generic: We could not save the defaults. Nothing was changed. Try again.

briefFormat.legend: How long should a brief be?
briefFormat.shortHint: The stage, the last order and what to carry.
briefFormat.fullHint: Everything in Short, plus context, obligations and court notes.

preview.title: Your court day, taking shape
preview.boardEmpty: Your imported matters will appear here.

states.offline: You are offline. Steps that need a connection are paused until you are back online.
states.denied: Only the chamber owner can do this step. Ask the owner to set it up, or to make you an owner.
states.deniedTitle: This step is for the owner
states.notFound: That step does not exist on this path.

error.body: Your progress is saved. Nothing was sent to anyone.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Shortcuts work anywhere except while you are typing in a field.
